title: Signal: pnpm lockfile in the legacy v5 format
scope: A pnpm-lock.yaml file that declares a pnpm lockfile in the v5 format, which records less resolution provenance per package.
limitations: It matches a pnpm lockfile in the v5 format, which records less resolution provenance per package in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pnpm-lock.yaml that mentions a pnpm lockfile in the v5 format, which records less resolution provenance per package in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
